portal-golive.summary:
* The main item is the customer portal go-live.
* The FPX payment gateway fails in UAT due to an expired bank certificate.
* The bank will send a new certificate by Wednesday.
* If the certificate is not received by Wednesday, the go-live will be pushed from February 3rd to February 10th.
* Fourteen accessibility issues were found on the claims form, to be fixed by next Friday.
* Data migration is at 80%, with remaining tasks involving manual review of duplicate IC numbers.
* Legal requires the old portal to be kept read-only for six months.
* The client-side UAT sign-off ownership is currently undefined.
decisions: Legal wants the old portal kept read-only for six months, so we agreed on six months.
